chapter: Disintegration of Second World & Collapse of Bipolarity
questionText:
Which among the following is correct about the consequences of the
collapse of the Soviet Union?
 
(A) The ideological dispute between socialist and capitalist systems came
to an end.
(B) The end to arms race and a possible new peace
(C) The US became the sole superpower
(D) Politically, liberal democracy emerged as the best way to organise
political life.
 
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 Contemporary World Politics (Chapter 2: The End of Bipolarity, 'Consequences of Disintegration'): (A) It led to the end of Cold War confrontations and ideological disputes between capitalism and socialism. (B) Power relations in world politics changed radically, resulting in a unipolar world led by the US. (C) It led to the emergence of many new countries, including the fifteen independent republics of the former USSR and post-communist Eastern European nations. (D) The international system saw many new players emerge, each with its own identity, interests, and distinct economic and political difficulties. All statements (A), (B), (C), and (D) are valid.
Hence, option (B) is correct.

questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: The constitutions of post-Soviet Central Asian republics concentrated overwhelming executive power in the hands of the President.
Statement II: In countries like Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan, the presidents appointed themselves for extended terms and allowed zero political opposition.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Assumed both statements were correct.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid NCERT facts erroneously.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement II.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Statement I is false while Statement II is factually sound.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct. In Central Asia, the presidents arrogated wide authoritarian powers, often extending their mandates for 10 to 20 years without permitting viable opposition parties.
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (D) is correct.
